description:
Check whether a combination of dimensions and metrics is valid for this property BEFORE running a report.

Avoids wasted report requests and token-heavy error loops. Also lists which other fields remain compatible with the given combination.

compatibilityFilter.description: Only return fields with this compatibility (recommended: COMPATIBLE)

propertyId.description: GA4 property ID to query (overrides the default GA_PROPERTY_ID). Accepts "123456789" or "properties/123456789". Use ga_get_account_summaries to discover IDs.

name: ga_check_compatibility
